name: Fukou no Aji o Shitteru ka
original_name: 不幸の味を知ってるか
source:
Become Natsumi-chan's imaginary friend who can look into the past of others, and look into the misfortune!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28049]Freem![/url]]
translation:
成为能够窥见他人过去的夏美所想象出来的朋友，尽情窥探别人的不幸吧！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28049]Freem![/url]]
